the development of a novel dosimeter for small radiation fields.
the use of high field micro‐MRI for the characterization of the 3D dose distribution for small radiation beams.
the development of new techniques for 3D polymer‐gel dosimetry with high resolution MR imaging.

the MAGIC polymer gel with 7 Tesla micro‐MRI is an excellent tool for 3D dosimetry of very small radiation fields.
the 7T MRI with the MAGIC gel is an ideal combination for accurate 3D dose distribution measurement for small radiation fields.
the MAGIC gel with high field micro‐MRI is a viable dosimetric tool for small radiation beams.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MAGIC‐MR gel dosimetry is a very promising method for dosimetry of very small radiation fields.
the MAGIC gel dosimeter is a good choice for dosimetric evaluation of small field size beams.
the 7T micro MRI is the best choice for the MAGIC gel dosimetry.

7T microMRI provides superior spatial resolution for MAGIC gel dosimetry.
the 7T micro MR scanner provides a better spatial resolution for the dose distribution than the 3T MR scanner.
the MAGIC gel with high field MR scanners provides superior quality dose maps compared to 1.5T and 3T MR scanners.
